summary: Prove catalan_G_numerical_bounds : G > 0.915 ∧ G < 0.916 (currently axiom with [lewin1981] ref)
comment: BorromeanVolumeCatalan.lean line ~140 has `axiom catalan_G_numerical_bounds : catalan_G > (0.915:ℝ) ∧ catalan_G < (0.916:ℝ)` (set during 2026-06-03 session a7f80972 batch). Proof strategy: alternating series Leibniz bound. For G = Σ (-1)^k/(2k+1)² with N=22, |G - S_22| ≤ 1/(2·23+1)² = 1/2209, S_22 ≈ 0.91594, so G ∈ (0.91549, 0.91639) ⊆ (0.915, 0.916). Needs Mathlib's alternating-series bound lemma (likely `Antitone.cauchySeq_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero` or similar — verify with lean_loogle when lake env available). Not attempted in 2026-06-03 session because remote env has no `lake` binary and `lean_leansearch` SSL-blocked, so Mathlib API names couldn't be verified before push.

data.proof_sketch: 1. Show series is alternating with antitone |terms| via `Antitone.cauchySeq_alternating_series_of_tendsto_zero`. 2. Use Leibniz error bound |G - S_N| ≤ a_{N+1}. 3. At N=22, compute S_22 as rational + norm_num. 4. linarith with 1/2209 envelope.
data.blocker: needs working `lake` + `lean-lsp` to verify Mathlib alternating-series API names
